title: Digital asset digest - August 20th 2026
summary: Bitcoin has spent the past month range bound between roughly US$62,000 and US$67,000, currently sitting near US$64,000, still about half its October peak of ~US$126,000. It remains a summer lull, with daily volumes running at around US$4-5bn on trusted exchanges and similarly thin activity across risk assets, so relatively small flows are moving price.
